name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Melon Berry
description: Juicy, refreshing, and bursting with berry sweetness. Double-Stacked Melon Berry BITEZ layer ripe, refreshing melon with sweet mixed berries for a smooth, fruity flavor that keeps every chew bright and delicious. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A refreshing fruit fusion stacked with serious potency.
